items.text: Bungee Jumping is an extreme adventure activity for which you have to be mentally and physically prepared.
Persons with medical conditions such as high blood pressure, heart conditions, back, neck or other injuries, any dislocation or fractures, or even pregnant women are not suitable for Bungee Jumping.
Individuals above 13 years and upto 45 years can do Bungee Jumping and the minimum weight required is 40 Kilograms.
If you fail to reach the location on the date and time allotted to you for Bungee Jumping, that will be considered as a NO SHOW and there shall be no refund

During heavy rain or any other bad weather condition, Bungy Jumping may be postponed or cancelled.
In case Bungee Jumping is postponed, you can do the activity on the next possible date and time which shall be informed to you.

answer.text: The best time to do Bungee Jumping in Meghalaya is during winters when the weather is dry, however other non monsoon days are also ideal for Bungee Jumping.
